audience: Partners, practice managers and legal operations leaders in established Sydney law firms
buyer: A law-firm partner or practice manager whose signed engagements still rely on people copying, checking and chasing information between systems
observable_moment: The client signs at 9:02 am, but at 3:47 pm the matter is still unopened and the first deadline remains in an inbox.
commercial_consequence: Billable work and client confidence wait after the firm has already won the engagement, while senior staff reconstruct the handoff.
run_lighter_mechanism: Use the signed engagement or approved intake as one trigger, assemble approved matter data once, expose missing inputs, open the normal path only after required statuses pass and route exceptions with context.
exception_path: Conflicts, identity concerns, scope changes, fee exceptions, urgent deadlines and capacity decisions go to the firm's approved human reviewer.
credible_next_action: Bring one recently opened matter and the firm's required checks to an on-site automation review.
problem: Signing ends the sales process without reliably starting the matter-opening process.
single_message: The value is not creating a task. It is transferring a signed commercial commitment into controlled, ready-to-work client work without asking software to make professional decisions.
supporting_points: Treat the signed engagement as a reliable trigger
Populate approved client and matter information once
Keep conflicts, scope, fee and identity judgement with people
Measure signed-to-ready time and incomplete handoffs
angle: A client has said yes, but billable work is still waiting between the e-signature, checks, inbox and practice-management system.

search_question: Why is a signed client still waiting for their matter to open?
direct_answer: Because signing often ends one process without starting the next. The engagement, conflict check, client details, scope, costs and responsible lawyer sit in separate systems or inboxes, so someone must notice, re-key and chase each handoff before billable work can begin.
